name: Luca Orlem
source:
Likes: Freedom and all ladies in this universe!
Dislikes: Stubborn studious guys
Hobby: Playing pranks on others
Skill: Skipping classes successfully in a professional manner

"Nothing will ever start if you just sit around waiting."

Elias: ...He is Luca Orlem, the self-conscious habitual idler having a fair share of serious behavioral issues. He repeated a couple years in the academy having the record receiving many detentions before.
A student like him stays in this such prestigious academy...
This fact is beyond my comprehension. Well...I must admit his magical power and skills are extraordinary.
Yet, he seems not caring much about his talent.

[Official in-game description]
